description.value: Cassidy Farm Market is a greengrocer on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Cassidy/Cedar area. It accepts both cash and card payments, making it accessible to most cyclists. As a dedicated grocery store, it provides fresh produce and staples useful for re-provisioning during a touring journey through the region.
